tools.name: search
tools.description: Search OpenPlanr docs passages. Optional section is the URL's first segment after /docs/ (for example skills or get-started), or course for course pages.

tools.name: fetch_page
tools.description: Read a docs or course page as Markdown. Accepts a /docs/... or /learn/... path, or an https://openplanr.dev/docs/... or https://openplanr.dev/learn/... URL; query and anchor do not change the page.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search OpenPlanr docs passages. Optional section is the URL's first segment after /docs/ (for example skills or get-started)." → after: "Search OpenPlanr docs passages. Optional section is the URL's first segment after /docs/ (for example skills or get-started), or course for course pages."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
